es.e: Spanish e is pure: don't let it drift toward [i] like English "say".
es.o: Spanish o is pure: don't let it drift toward [u] like English "go".
es.i: Keep i tight and steady, like a held "ee".
es.u: Round your lips firmly and keep the tongue back.
es.a: Open wide and hold it still.

zh.y: Say [i], then round your lips without moving your tongue.
zh.ɤ: Start from [o] and unround your lips; keep the tongue back.

ar.eː: Levantine ē is a pure [eː], not "ay".
ar.oː: Levantine ō is a pure [oː], not "oh-oo".
